title: README.md claims a PR shipped, but it never actually merged
author: off-by-one
description: Reads README.md's own text for a ships/includes/merges/via #N claim phrase and cross-checks it against the live pull-request tracker. The PR-side twin of readme-claims-open-milestone and readme-claims-unfixed-issue -- README's own claims-X family had a milestone leg and an issue leg but no PR leg, unlike the release and tweet families, which both already carry all three.
confidence_notes: Deliberately NOT age-gated, the same reasoning readme-claims-open-milestone and readme-claims-unfixed-issue already gave for their own README reads. A GetFileContents read of README.md returns current text, not a change history, so there is no per-claim timestamp to weigh a staleness window against -- and no race to guard against either: a README is read live, right now, so a claim it currently makes and the PR's currently-unmerged state are both true at the same instant the scan runs. Flat 0.85 on every surfaced claim; a claim naming a nonexistent PR, or one that is genuinely merged, is excluded at 0.0, named not hidden.
